letter_deductions.deduction: Claim not admissible: Date of admission falls outside the policy period (Clause 2)
letter_deductions.why: Admission 4 Sep 2026 is within the period 1 Sep 2026 - 31 Aug 2027 stated in the schedule; the renewal is continuous since 2021.

notes: Rejection is contradicted by the schedule. Payable computed as for an admissible claim.
